text: Confirmed and filed #6580: JUSTEXT accepts 260-byte ASCII paths that installed VFP9 SP2 rejects with error 202; the 259-byte boundary returns txt in VFP9. Copperfin accepts the 260-byte path and returns txt. Path components were kept below component limits. Issue open, owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. VFP JUSTEXT Language Reference confirms max cPath length 259 bytes. No production edits.
